fit_boundary_rule: All heldout352 query chemistry excluded: official identity, formula, nonempty scaffold, Morgan Tanimoto>=0.70 and known acquisition alias groups. No old retrieval-head weights reused.
training_unit: One equally weighted identity; mean of its existing supported positive acquisition embeddings, mean metadata and adduct frequencies.
query_unit: Mean of all supported positive acquisitions per query. Explicit parent fallback for unsupported queries; negative acquisitions are not falsely scored by DreaMS.
scaling: Input means/std from fitting identities only, standardize and clip at5. MoLFormer targets centered by fitting-only mean, then unit normalized.

gpu.checkpoint_selection: Final fixed30000 updates only; no validation labels or checkpoint-quality search.

serving_candidate_policy: Score only real complete-pipeline candidate lists. Never add true structures or reuse truth-forced diagnostic candidate files.
development_policy: Select any serving weight with grouped development only. Freeze both candidate recipes before source stress; use correct mixed-polarity and all-query zero accounting.
exposure_limit: Frozen public encoders and the parent pipeline may have historical exposure. These clean boundaries apply to new fitted heads, not an assertion of universal pretraining exclusion.
correction: Exclude the5additional original-row-linked fitting identities found by C41 before quality metrics. Retrain both heads from scratch; preserve fixed hyperparameters and schedules.
